ticket_price.note: Competitor entry $20 per division, max two entries (Fair Go 25). Spectator entry not stated. Prize pool over $10,000 funded by local businesses and skate-industry backers (2025).

add_sources.note: @fairgoskatecomp 'Registration is NOW OPEN for Fair Go 25' (6 Oct 2025). Google snippet of the post lists 'Sponsors: @findlayhats @powellperalta @boneswheels @whitakerskateboards @partnerskateboards @thefurniturecompany @rockstarbearings ...' (list cut off). Post co-authored with Truckstop Skate Shop, Truckstop Skate School, Byron Skate School, 36 Chambers Skateshop and NRSK8.

Ballina Shire Council minutes, Dec 2025: Fair Go Skate Competition requested 10,000 and was allocated 6,000 under the festival and event sponsorship program (Google snippet); Dec 2024 agenda also shows 6,000.

@fairgoskatecomp (11 Jun 2026): 'Greetings past and hopefully future Fair Go Sponsors!... Fair Go 26 is coming soon and is a great tax deductable, community event... Click the link in our bio and join in... as a sponsor'. A later 2026 post repeats 'Do you want to sponsor Fair Go this year? Contact us or click the link in our Bio' (https://www.instagram.com/p/DeJdEs6O7mF/, Google snippet).
'Entry is $20 per division (max 2 entries - one park & one bowl)'.
English-language listing: Fair Go Skate Competition, Kingsford Smith Drive, Ballina, 9 to 10 October 2026 (Google snippet). ATDW listing says it 'returns for its 26th year'.
